Destiny ownership/copy identity and in-flight projectile attribution

projectIntegrationPolicy.session: Maintain a timed session per owned ItemStack object; keep and advance decay while it is stowed.
projectIntegrationPolicy.kill: Credit a confirmed weapon final blow to its original stack only while the owner still possesses it and its exact Rampage socket is still selected, even if another weapon is now held.
projectIntegrationPolicy.refresh: After bringing due decay current, a qualifying kill adds one stack up to three and resets the next decay deadline to now+90, including at the cap.
projectIntegrationPolicy.decay: Each elapsed 90-tick interval removes one stack; process every elapsed interval and preserve the remaining interval when catching up. Never clear all stacks on the first expiry.
projectIntegrationPolicy.stow: Retain the session and its deadline through switching; stowing grants no extra time.
projectIntegrationPolicy.projectile: Capture the emitted shot's multiplier; later stack changes or a kill's newly granted stack do not retroactively alter that shot.
projectIntegrationPolicy.identity: Copies and new owners start without this object's session; no session inheritance. Possession/selection loss invalidates kill credit and the session.
projectIntegrationPolicy.boundary: These are the agreed W66 runtime integration rules. The sources do not prove object identity, ownership transfer, emitted-shot snapshots or transaction ordering.

limitations: No live Destiny test or exhaustive later-patch audit; pinned evidence is not a current sandbox certification.
Pool eligibility grants an optional roll, not automatic trait selection on every weapon copy.
No enhanced, Huckleberry, catalyst, same-name reissue, sword or glaive eligibility inferred.
Base damage and separate explosive-damage perks require their own integration decisions; this resource only supplies Rampage's scalar.
